name: Faerie
description: Winged, insectile creatures who undergo a metamorphosis during their lifetime, Faerie names are short and bright, chosen anew sometimes after their change.

features.name: Luckbender
features.description: Once per session, after you or a willing ally within Close range makes an action roll, you can spend 3 Hope to reroll the Duality Dice.

features.name: Wings
features.description: You can fly. While flying, you can mark a Stress after an adversary makes an attack against you to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against that attack.
